name: Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size of the Projected-Teaching Monotonicity Separation Class
proof: The four-concept subfamily $\{1000,0100,0010,0001\}$ has projected minimum teaching-set size three. Exhaustive enumeration of all 31 nonempty subfamilies shows none has larger value. Therefore the subclass maximum is three; see sync/verify_projected_teaching_values.py.
